For supporting steps like 'Verify Shortcuts Screen', always include the verification assertion after navigating to the shortcuts screen. 5. For combined steps (e.g., '5. The click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button. | 6. Verify the screen.'), ensure both actions (click and verify) are implemented as per the mapped script line and intermediary steps. 6.
